questions: Is the unsteadiness and abnormal movement a new change from your usual condition?
Did it begin suddenly?
Did it begin after a fall, blow to the head, or other injury?
Have you had brain or neck surgery recently?
Have you had a stroke, brain bleed, or other brain injury recently?
Did you lose consciousness before or during this episode?
Are you confused or less alert than usual?
Are you having a severe or worsening headache?
Are you having new weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Are you having trouble speaking, understanding, or seeing?
Do you feel that the room is spinning?
Do you have double vision?
Are you vomiting or severely nauseated?
Have you had shaking, stiffening, or jerking episodes?
Were you aware of what was happening during the abnormal movements?
Have you bitten your tongue or lost bladder control?
Have you had a fever or suspected infection recently?
Have you taken any new sedatives, antiseizure medicines, pain medicines, or other drugs?
Could you have received more medication than intended?
Did these movements occur before the current hospitalization?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: MRI-negative focal epilepsy causing focal aware/impaired-awareness versive seizures, most likely of frontal-lobe origin

ALTERNATIVE 1: Functional neurological symptom disorder with functional seizures (psychogenic nonepileptic seizures)

ALTERNATIVE 2: Focal epilepsy arising from the temporal or parietal lobe

ALTERNATIVE 3: Drug- or toxic-metabolic-induced encephalopathy/seizures despite initially normal screening tests
